description:
The Keller–Gehrig characteristic-polynomial path in `crates/gf2-core/src/field/charpoly.rs` solves with $K^{-1}$ through PLE, which the Strassen-based product does not accelerate; its dispatch threshold reflects that cost.

## Background

The module documentation named the replacement and the lower threshold as planned work; the source-comment sweep removed that statement, and this issue tracks it.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The $K^{-1}$ step uses an inversion built on the fast matrix product, with results equal to the current path on the shared characteristic-polynomial test suite.
- [hard] REQ-02: Any change to the dispatch threshold cites a committed benchmark receipt from the overnight benchmark window, per `@/inv/benchmark-backed-performance`.
title: Replace the Keller-Gehrig inverse solve with a Strassen-amenable inversion
